nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf tracking token balances of every holder
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] used by transferFrom to spend on behalf
Public totalSupply of the YUMv3 token
Private owner address, set to msg.sender at construction; gates delegate() and batchSend()
Public token name string
Public token symbol string
Constant UNI (Uniswap router) address stored in the contract
Constant decimals = 18
transfer(_to,_value) payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transferFrom(_from,_to,_value) payable with ensure modifier; debits allowance and balances without SafeMath
approve(_spender,_value) sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval
delegate(a,b) payable; requires msg.sender == owner and performs low-level delegatecall to arbitrary address
batchSend(_tos,_value) payable; owner-only loop minting-ish transfers with unchecked multiplication
ensure modifier; recomputes Uniswap pair via pairFor and requires _from or _to be owner or the pair
pairFor(factory,tokenA,tokenB) internal pure; computes CREATE2 Uniswap pair address
Constructor(name,symbol,supply) payable; sets metadata, owner and mints entire supply to deployer
msg.sender used in transferFrom for allowance spending and self-transfer checks
msg.sender used as authorization check (== owner) in delegate and batchSend
msg.sender captured in the constructor and assigned to the owner state variable
Raw a.delegatecall(b) low-level call executing arbitrary calldata in this contract's storage context
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend (Solidity 0.5, no SafeMath)
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value inside batchSend loop
Parameter _to of transfer(address,uint)
Parameter _value of transfer(address,uint)
Parameter _from of transferFrom(address,address,uint)
Parameter _to of transferFrom(address,address,uint)
Parameter _value of transferFrom(address,address,uint)
Parameter _spender of approve(address,uint)
Parameter _value of approve(address,uint)
Parameter a (target address) of delegate(address,bytes)
Parameter b (calldata) of delegate(address,bytes)
Parameter _tos (address array) of batchSend(address[],uint)
Parameter _value of batchSend(address[],uint)
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend
Loop counter i in batchSend
Local variable _to = _tos[i] inside the batchSend loop
Constructor parameter _name
Constructor parameter _symbol
Constructor parameter _supply (initial total supply)

edges.reason: msg.sender from the deployer drives constructor execution and ownership initialization
msg.sender is written into the owner state variable, granting full privileged control to the deployer
constructor mints the whole supply into balanceOf[msg.sender]
constructor grants infinite allowance from msg.sender to the Uniswap router address
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether allowance must be consumed in transferFrom
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the arbitrary delegatecall in delegate()
require(msg.sender == owner) gates batchSend()
user-supplied target address a flows into the delegatecall destination
user-supplied bytes b flows directly into the delegatecall calldata
delegate() body executes the raw delegatecall unsafe operation
batchSend computes the unchecked product total
_value multiplies _tos.length with no overflow protection
_tos.length participates in the unchecked multiplication for total
result of the unchecked multiplication total feeds the unchecked balance subtraction
local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath
unchecked subtraction mutates the balanceOf state mapping
batchSend loop performs an unchecked balance addition per recipient
_value is added to each recipient balance without overflow checks
recipient address _to from the array indexes the balance addition
unchecked addition mutates the balanceOf state mapping

_value parameter flows into the transfer wrapper
